review:
Burning Chilli 243 updates BGaming's chilli classic with 243 ways to win, a high-energy soundtrack and polished graphics. The base game is a straightforward ways slot.

The free spins round changes the rules: during the bonus, all symbols pay anywhere on the reels rather than across ways, which makes wins much more frequent while it lasts. Chance x2 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates the game low volatility with a modest 500x maximum, and the RTP is 97%. Free spins arrive about once every 242 spins. A calm option for long sessions.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
